description: Create or update evidence tracking records (editor+): create one from a catalog id, upsert one record's tracking fields, or batch-upsert up to 500 in one transaction. Pick with method.

collecting_system.description: Name of the tool or system that collects the evidence Used by: create, update.

comments.description: Free-text notes or context Used by: create, update.

evidence_id.description: Catalog evidence ID (e.g., 'E-IAM-01') — obtain from scf_list_evidence_catalog [create] | Catalog evidence ID (e.g., 'E-IAM-01') — obtain from scf_list_evidence or scf_list_evidence_catalog [update] Used by: create, update.

frequency.description: Collection cadence: 'daily', 'weekly', 'monthly', 'quarterly', or 'annually' Used by: create, update.

is_tracked.description: Start actively tracking this item (default false) [create] | Toggle active tracking for this item [update] Used by: create, update.

maturity_level.description: Evidence maturity level L0–L5 (e.g., 'L3'); omit to leave unset [create] | Evidence maturity level L0–L5 (e.g., 'L3'); omitting never clears the stored value [update] Used by: create, update.

method.description:
create: Create an evidence tracking record from a catalog evidence ID (write — editor+ role). Starts tracking an evidence item for the organization.
update: Upsert an evidence item's tracking fields (write — editor+ role). Creates the tracking row if missing. All body fields are optional; only provided fields are applied.
batch_update: Create or update up to 500 evidence tracking records in one transaction (write — editor role). Each upserts by evidence_id; only fields given change. Use instead of 500 scf_update_evidence calls.

method_of_collection.description: Collection approach: 'automated', 'manual', or 'hybrid' Used by: create, update.

operations.description: Upsert operations, max 500 — each keyed by evidence_id Used by: batch_update.

assigned_user_id.description: User responsible for collecting — becomes assignee on generated tasks; must be in the owning team

collecting_system.description: Name of the tool or system that collects the evidence

comments.description: Free-text notes on this evidence item

is_tracked.description: Toggle active tracking for this item

owner_user_id.description: User accountable for this evidence — task assignee when assigned_user_id is unset

system_id.description: System that collects this evidence — obtain from scf_list_systems

owner.description: Person accountable for this evidence item Used by: create, update.

system_id.description: System UUID to link this evidence to — obtain from scf_list_systems Used by: create, update.

name: scf_evidence_write
